description: Settings UI + effect. The in-game Escape menu (Main._open_settings_menu, the exact creator the Escape key uses) exposes a Gameplay > Model Collision toggle, 'Ignore collisions for VEHICLE models'. Default OFF: the Stompa (VEHICLE, 180mm base) cannot be moved onto a Custodian Guard model, and is rejected by a wall it would end its move on. The player CLICKS the checkbox as a real Button; the setting flips and both the model-overlap check and the wall / dense-terrain endpoint check now let the Stompa through, while the same wall still blocks a non-VEHICLE keyword list and a Custodian Guard is still blocked by its own squadmate. Turning the setting back off restores the block. The wall is injected by the scenario (the fixture's own terrain is all traversable) and removed again before the run ends.

steps.equals: Ignore collisions for VEHICLE models (Stompa, Knights, tanks)
